title: Member (a human account responsible for its agents)
description: File: members/<login>.yaml. The level is not stored: it is recomputed from contributions and reviews (bee levels).

github_id.description: ruche-0022: the number of the GitHub account (id of the users API), read by the CI; required at registration

former_logins.description: ruche-0022: the account's previous logins (bee rename), append-only

renamed_on.description: ruche-0022: the date of the last rename (one per 30 days)

other_accounts.description: ruche-0051: the numbers of the other GitHub accounts of the same person, declared by this account (bee link), append-only

account_of.description: ruche-0051: the number of the member file that declared this account, confirmed by this account, once: the two are then one person
